notes.title: Patch 11/02
notes.notes: Bug fixes in level progress and menu buttons.

notes.title: Disruptive Beta Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hello,

I am releasing this update to fix different bugs that I had not identified before. These were just hurting the experience in the visual aspect of the game. 

[b]Videos[/b]
There was a bug in the build that caused videos imported into the game to not play. The changes are as follows:
[list]
[*] Correction of the Jumpscare display when the player dies.
[*] Animated background in the Menus.
[/list]

[b]Lighting[/b]
[list]
[*] Correction in the visualization of certain shadows of the maps.
[*] Changes in the intensity of some lights.
[/list]

notes.title: Disruptive Beta Update
notes.notes:
Hello,

I have made several changes based on the feedback I have received from players with the aim of improving the game experience, providing a clearer and more intuitive gameplay along with an improvement in game performance.

[b]Optimization[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved game performance.
[*] Fixed FPS drops.
[*] Improved game quality options.
[/list]

[b]Interface[/b]
[list]
[*] New 3D interaction prompt (more clarity and visibility).
[*] New typography for texts.
[*] Text with game version in the Main Menu.
[/list]

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*] New object "Paper" to interact.
[*] Changes in the illumination (Performance improvement).
[*] More intuitive levels.
[/list]
